styleSource.notes: Two-stage generation: spectre portrait generated first from the ghost-subject's selfie, then composited with the victim-subject's selfie into a film-negative haunting strip.

surfaceBehavior.live: Shows haunting strip composite image only.
surfaceBehavior.screen: Shows both the spectre portrait and the haunting strip composite in sequence.
surfaceBehavior.admin: Shows ghost/victim assignment for the round before reveal.

_extensions.pairingNotes: Each player is ghost and victim exactly once across the round set, via single-cycle derangement. Round order is shuffled at the mode level (not just within pairing) to prevent order from leaking the ghost/victim mapping.
